actions.createBot.description: Creates a new bot that will join a meeting
actions.createBot.props.bot_name.descrip: The name of the bot that will be displayed in the call (max 100 characters). Defaults to "Meeting Notetaker"
actions.createBot.props.meeting_url.desc: The URL of the meeting (e.g., https://zoom.us/j/123?pwd=456)
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.retrieveBot.description: Get details about a specific bot instance
actions.retrieveBot.props.bot_id.descrip: A UUID string identifying the bot
actions.sendChatMessage.description: Causes the bot to send a message in the meeting chat
actions.sendChatMessage.props.bot_id.des: A UUID string identifying the bot
actions.sendChatMessage.props.message.de: The message that will be sent (max 4096 characters)
actions.sendChatMessage.props.pin.descri: Whether to pin the message in the chat
actions.sendChatMessage.props.to.descrip: The person or group that the message will be sent to. Defaults to "everyone". On non-Zoom platforms, only "everyone" is supported
auth.props.server.description: The Recall AI server to connect to.
